explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/63 (Mihók–Erdős): does every graph with infinite chromatic number contain a cycle of length 2^n for infinitely many n? Solved affirmatively, following Liu–Montgomery. The statement takes any G with chromaticNumber = ⊤, of arbitrary cardinality, and asserts that for every N some n ≥ N has 2^n ∈ cycleLengths, i.e. infinitely many such n. Faithful.
